note: Revisit domain registry for Scout Intent. Debian LTS security triage for bookworm: decide new CVEs, commit one of two proposed decisions, watch and recall deferred decisions, query evidence (Zetaris) and memory (H-MEM).

intents.description: Safe fallback when no registered intent clears the Reject band. Answers conversationally, routes to no tools, never guesses a high-risk intent.
examples: hello
what can you do?
thanks, that's all

intents.description: Decide a new CVE for Debian bookworm: propose URGENT, NEXT, WONTFIX or NOTAFF from tracker evidence and team memory.
examples: Triage CVE-2026-1234 in openssl for bookworm
Decide what to do with the new CVE in libxml2
New vulnerability in curl: is it urgent for bookworm?
Classify CVE-2026-5555 for Debian bookworm as URGENT, NEXT, WONTFIX or NOTAFF
Should this new nginx CVE be fixed now or in the next point release?

intents.description: Adopt one of two proposed decisions for a CVE (the evidence path's or the memory path's) and record it. High impact: the decision is written to team memory and the world model.
examples: Commit the triage decision for CVE-2026-1234 in openssl
Adopt one of the two proposed decisions for this CVE
Pick between the evidence proposal and the memory proposal and record it
Finalize the decision for CVE-2026-5555 in curl
Record the gatekeeper's choice for libxml2

intents.description: Daily watch over deferred CVE decisions: check whether any reopen condition (upstream fix, exploit, severity change) has fired.
examples: Run the daily watch over deferred CVEs
Check whether any deferred decision's reopen conditions fired today
Did anything change for the postponed CVEs?
Scan deferred items for new upstream fixes or exploits

intents.description: Bring a deferred decision back into the triage queue so it is decided again with today's evidence.
examples: Bring back the deferred decision for CVE-2026-1234
Reopen the postponed openssl CVE
Revisit the WONTFIX we parked for curl last month
Pull the deferred libxml2 decision back into the queue

intents.description: Run a read-only federated SQL query on Zetaris over the security tracker, advisories and package data.
examples: Run a federated SQL query on Zetaris for all open CVEs in openssl
Query Zetaris: which bookworm packages have a fix upstream?
Select from the tracker table where status is open
Show the evidence rows for CVE-2026-1234 from the data lake

intents.description: Look up H-MEM: earlier team decisions, current stances and similar past CVEs for a package.
examples: What did we decide last time for openssl?
Look up H-MEM for earlier decisions on curl
Recall the stance memory holds for libxml2
Search memory for similar CVEs in nginx
